title: Phase 1: data package — workspace, manifest, extraction, images, validator, loader
description:
Pointer: DESIGN.md § 2 (source material and hazards), § 3 (data layout), § 4 (validation rules), § 5 (pipeline), § 8 (stack).

Scope in: the pnpm workspace with packages/data; the hand-maintained manifest; a deterministic extractor from the official PDF to 18 Portuguese chunk files and 15 image files; the validator wired into lint; a typed loader. Scope out: translations, glossary, hints, the web app (phases 2 to 4 in DESIGN.md § 5).
notes:
**DECISIONS** (epic-scoped log; durable record in DESIGN.md § 9, written in this planning session)
- Portuguese question files are generated by the extractor only; a hand fix goes into the extractor's correction table so a rerun reproduces it. DESIGN.md § 9, 2026-10-13.
- Chunk files follow DESIGN.md § 3.1 exactly: 18 files, none over 51 questions, none spanning a section, Biology split along species runs.
- Topics follow DESIGN.md § 3.2: per species inside Biology, the section slug elsewhere, assigned by id range from the manifest.
- The manifest is the hand-maintained spec (DESIGN.md § 3.4) and both scripts read it; nothing about chunks, topics or images is hard-coded in a script.
- Images are mapped by position in the PDF (DESIGN.md § 2.3): 14 species photos plus one sign shared by four questions, 15 files, 18 questions with an image.
- The earlier parse (DESIGN.md § 2.4) is a cross-check, never an input: its answers are right for all 506, its text is wrong on the ids listed in § 2.2.
- Stack mirrors Sumit with no server (DESIGN.md § 8); no pull requests, no walkthrough (user, 2026-10-13).

**SEQUENCING**
planned=4 beads in 0 groups, sonnet=3 opus=1.
.1 alone: it sets the workspace and writes the manifest the other three read. Then .2, then .3, then .4, one after another; this is a personal project and the beads share packages/data. Hazards: none named yet; `packages/data/manifest.json` is written by .1 and read by every later bead.

**ACCEPTANCE BAR**
Commands a person runs from a fresh clone, with what they see:
1. `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use && pnpm install && pnpm lint && pnpm test`: all green.
2. `ls packages/data/questions`: exactly the 18 files named in DESIGN.md § 3.1.

- Anything about English, glossary or hints: belongs to phase 2 or 3 (DESIGN.md § 5); file a bead there, do not add it here.
- Never widened inside a bead: the chunk table, the topic table, the manifest shape, the question shape.
- A wrong DECISION: record the reversal here and in DESIGN.md § 9 and carry on.

**DONE MEANS**

title: Review fixes B: rule 6 hyphen boundary and apostrophes, glossary shape, manifest fixtures
description:
Shard: data-package. Status: confirmed (5 findings, 2 skeptics each).
1. validate.mjs checkGlossary whole-word regex treats '-' as a boundary, so a glossary pt 'Perdiz' matches inside 'perdiz-cinzenta' and the validator demands 'Red-legged partridge' in a grey-partridge translation. Fix: add '-' to both lookaround classes.
2. checkGlossary only matches the exact surface form: a glossary pt with a straight apostrophe never matches the bank's curly ’ (galinha-d’água), so rule 6 silently passes. Fix: normalise ’ to ' and “ ” to " on both sides before matching. Do not fail on a glossary entry that matches no question (the glossary will also hold species from Portaria 67/2024 that are not in the bank). Plurals are out of scope; say so in DESIGN.md § 4 rule 6 (the glossary pt must be the surface form used in the bank; a plural is its own entry).
3. The glossary entry check accepts empty strings and skips uniqueness and the scientific/group fields, unlike every other list: an entry with en '' turns rule 6 off for that species (includes('') is always true); an empty pt matches everything. Fix: use checkEntries(rel, 'species', glossary, 'pt', { pt: 'string', scientific: 'string', en: 'string', group: 'string' }).
4. Two manifest checks have no fixture: topic ranges that stop short of the section end (the 'topic ranges of section X end at' message) and a section with no topic. Add expectFailure cases.
5. Three more manifest checks have no fixture: image page or index below 1, image with an empty questions list, chunk naming an unknown section. Add expectFailure cases.
Record the rule 6 changes in DESIGN.md § 4 rule 6.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint and pnpm test green; fixture tests show: 'Perdiz' in the glossary does not fire on a question that only says perdiz-cinzenta; a glossary pt with a straight apostrophe matches the bank's curly one and a wrong English name then fails naming the file and id; a glossary entry with empty en, empty pt, a duplicate pt or a missing scientific/group fails naming glossary/species.json; the five manifest checks listed each fail by name in a fixture; DESIGN.md § 4 rule 6 states the hyphen, apostrophe and plural rules.
notes:
READ FIRST: DESIGN.md § 4 (rules 6 and the manifest paragraph), § 3.3; packages/data/scripts/lib/validate.mjs (checkGlossary, checkEntries, checkManifest); packages/data/test/validate.test.ts and test/fixtures/valid/.

title: Review fixes A: extractor corrections hygiene, correction-key guard, extractor regression tests, hazard 8 wording
description:
Shard: data-package. Status: confirmed (4 findings, 2 skeptics each).
1. extract.mjs toEntries: CORRECTIONS text (fix.question, fix.options[X]) is written verbatim, skipping clean(); validator rule 3 only rejects CR/LF and a double ASCII space, so a tab, NBSP or U+2028 in a correction passes lint. Fix: run clean() on corrected text and apply finish()'s empty and '*' checks to it; in validate.mjs checkField reject any whitespace other than a single U+0020 between words (e.g. /[^\S ]/ or /\s{2,}/) and treat U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 as line breaks; add fixture tests for a tab and an NBSP.
2. extract.mjs CORRECTIONS guard compares string keys with numbers: 'q411' or '411 ' passes (NaN comparisons) and the fix is silently never applied; option keys other than A/B/C and unknown fields are dropped silently. Fix: require /^[1-9]\d*$/ keys within 1..total, options keys only A/B/C, fields only question/options; fail loudly otherwise.
3. No test covers the extractor: a regression in joinPieces (hazard 3) or the pdftotext mode (hazard 8) or the curly quotes (hazard 7) leaves lint and test green. Fix: (a) a test packages/data/test/extract.test.ts that compares questions/*.json with source/reference-2026-05.json: answer letter equal on all 506; stem and options equal after collapsing whitespace on every id except 10, 58, 320, 361, 412, 415, 462, 474, 479, 498 (heading glued in the reference) and 411, 455 (hyphen artefact), and asserts 411 option B contains 'pôr-do-sol', 455 question contains 'perdiz-vermelha', and 229 keeps curly quotes where the PDF has them (grep the data for a “ example); (b) move the pure parsing functions (clean, joinPieces, parseQuestions) into packages/data/scripts/lib/parse.mjs with a .d.mts, imported by extract.mjs, and unit-test parseQuestions on a small inline text with the hazards of DESIGN.md § 2.2 (separator variants, glued '*', wrapped lines, hyphen rejoin, heading after last option, 'ICNF' alone on a line, intro paragraph). extract.mjs must still produce byte-identical output (pnpm extract twice, git status clean).
4. DESIGN.md § 2.2 hazard 8 is wrong on its cases: default pdftotext gives 'pôr-dosol' in 411 and 'perdizvermelha' in 455; -raw drops spaces in 412 (B and C), 443, 455 and 461. Reword it with the right ids.
